hypothesis: A reel that exposes one hidden total-price trap and asks viewers to comment their price/composition/shipping fee will create more comments, private replies, saves, and follows than a generic deal announcement.

audience.primary_persona: Korean vape-liquid buyer comparing online deals
audience.pain: Deals look cheap until composition, shipping, device fit, or refill timing changes the real value.
audience.desire: A simple trusted calculator that tells them whether a deal is actually worth buying.
audience.follow_reason: Follow YUNA to get a repeated price-check table before buying.

content_angle: One deal that looks cheap but loses after shipping/composition is recalculated.
behavioral_trigger: loss aversion, curiosity gap, authority shortcut, social proof through comments
cta: 댓글에 가격/구성/배송비 남기면 YUNA가 점수표로 다시 계산합니다. 매일 딜 거르려면 팔로우.

risk_gate.notes: This sample is a draft. It must not publish or send live DM without the normal Instagram approval workflow.

success_metrics.minimum_signal_threshold: Keep variants that improve comment rate or follows per reach by at least 25 percent over the prior 7-day median.

variants.first_frame: 싼 척하는 전담액상 딜, 배송비 넣으면 점수 바뀝니다
variants.opening_line: 이 가격, 유나가 다시 계산하면 생각보다 안 쌉니다.
variants.caption_cta: 댓글에 가격/구성/배송비 남기면 YUNA 점수표로 답장합니다. 이런 계산 계속 보려면 팔로우.
variants.comment_prompt: 가격 / 구성 / 배송비를 한 줄로 남겨주세요.

variants.caption_cta: 저장해두고 살 때마다 비교하세요. 댓글 남기면 YUNA가 계산표 보냅니다.
variants.comment_prompt: 브랜드명 없이 가격, 용량, 배송비만 남겨도 됩니다.

decision_rule: After at least 3 approved posts or 72 hours, compare primary metrics against the 7-day median; keep the stronger hook family and generate 5 new variants from the winner.
